overview_description.description: Grepr provides an AI-driven observability platform focused on log volume reduction and faster incident analysis. The service uses machine learning to filter redundant or low-value events while preserving critical data, cutting storage and ingestion costs without requiring migrations. Built-in AI assistance helps troubleshoot production issues and can recommend remediation based on patterns in logs. The platform integrates with existing pipelines through agents and ingestion endpoints, and supports Single Sign-On with SAML across common identity providers. A hosted UI enables search and exploration across collected log streams. SOC 2 controls and a public trust center document security practices.
